definition: A variant of the Adam optimizer that decouples weight decay from the gradient-based update, improving generalization.
details: AdamW is now the default optimizer for training most large transformer-based language models, replacing the L2-regularization approach used in the original Adam.
story: Think of a hiker descending a foggy hill in the dark, taking small steps and feeling for the steepest way down. Think of it this way: A variant of the Adam optimizer that decouples weight decay from the gradient-based update, improving generalization. And here is the clever part: AdamW is now the default optimizer for training most large transformer-based language models, replacing the L2-regularization approach used in the original Adam. Skill, for a model, is just error pushed down until it is small enough to ignore. And that is AdamW — the quiet loop that turns flailing into skill.
